prior_gap: The registry accepted native READY with semantic_ready:true even without a requested readiness predicate, frame-scoped evidence, or a matching readiness.status. That could falsely report successful UI readiness to the Web model.

red.failure: A READY receipt with no final-frame proof was accepted, and READY with an internal NOT_READY completion status was accepted.

fix: The registry now accepts READY only after an explicit readiness request and a matching READY semantic receipt with the final frame/generation, ui_ready mode and OCR predicate. Any non-READY observation with semantic_ready:true is rejected. Requested readiness.status must agree with the outer native observation status.
test_changes: Explicit RED regressions for READY without frame-scoped semantic evidence and for contradictory readiness status.
Regression for NOT_READY contradicting its semantic_ready flag, and positive NOT_READY with semantic_ready:false.
Positive UIA, mixed-diff, ACK and frame-publication fixtures now carry realistic requested readiness and a matching per-frame semantic receipt, including grant rotation and abort preservation.

limitations: Local MCP/registry fixture proof only; real Swift capture readiness, foreground target, authenticated GPT Web semantic interpretation and actual pixel relay remain unverified. No full VIEW-P0-05 PASS claim is justified.
